target_applications: AI/robotics research, logistics, manufacturing, retail, healthcare, education

height_mm.source: https://humanoidspecs.com/robots/dexmate-vega (folds to 660 mm; extends to 2200 mm working height per vendor)

dof_per_arm.source: https://humanoid.guide/product/vega/ (vendor counts 13 DoF/arm incl. end effector)

reach_mm.source: https://dexmate.ai/product/vega (max working height with torso extended)

payload_per_arm_kg.source: https://dexmate.ai/product/vega ("10+ lbs per arm at any pose"); NOTE: 15 kg/arm circulates in third-party aggregators, unverified

torso_lift.value: 3-DoF foldable torso; folds to 0.66 m, working range floor to 2.2 m

runtime_h.source: https://dexmate.ai/product/vega (10+ h; >30 h with arms unloaded; aggregators cite 20-25 h)

actuators.value: brushless motors with harmonic gear reduction

end_effector.value: modular; 12-DoF five-finger dexterous hand option (10 fingers total) or gripper; sold separately in Vega-U config

media_at_flange.value: n/a (not disclosed); body I/O: 4x USB 3.2, Ethernet, DisplayPort, 5V/12V rails

compute.value: Intel x86 CPU + NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin (32/64 GB) at launch; 2026 page advertises NVIDIA AGX Thor

software_stack.value: closed-source stack; pip-installable Python SDK; URDF/USD sim assets; VR/exoskeleton teleoperation; compliance control; LLM integration; ROS compatibility per aggregators

safety_compliance.value: no certifications claimed; F/T-based compliance control marketed for safe human interaction

price.value: USD 89,999 MSRP ($999 preorder deposit); some third-party listings cite USD 80,000; Vega-U valued at USD 45,000 excl. end effector

availability.value: orderable via shop.dexmate.ai; lead time ~3 weeks (2026), ~3 months at 2025 launch; US-centric

deployment_evidence.value: in testing with unnamed publicly traded companies (manufacturing, logistics, retail); 6 Vega-U grant units to US universities; no public unit counts

notes: Payload conflict: vendor '10+ lbs per arm at any pose' vs widely repeated 15 kg/arm (discovery file used 15 kg). Runtime quoted variously 10+/20/25/30 h. Founders: Tao Chen (CEO, MIT PhD), Yuzhe Qin (CTO, UCSD PhD), Chongyang Wang (COO, MIT). ~$41M funding incl. LG Technology Ventures/LG CNS (Feb 2026); NVIDIA Inception; Red Dot 2025.
